scope: DW-14 follow-up: navigation tooltip hit testing and Quick Jump placeholder sizing

before.observation: Placeholder visibly truncates; measured text width is 360.1875px while the input content box is 261px.

after.observation: Visible placeholder “Поиск” fits; visually hidden accessible label remains “Найти канал или человека”. The participant expansion action wraps without horizontal overflow.

navigation_hint.trigger: At 1440px the hint overlapped the next channel row and intercepted a pointer click.
navigation_hint.before_fix: Focused browser regression failed: clicking the covered row left aria-current unset.
navigation_hint.after_fix: Focused browser regression passed; nav-only hints are pointer-transparent and remain described by aria-describedby.

registered_acceptance.authenticated_real_stack: PASS at desktop 1440 CSS px and touch 393 CSS px; PostgreSQL, Go API, Tempo and LiveKit; owned resources removed

capture_review.reuse_rule: Reuse only exact SHA-256 image matches; no new screenshot baseline was approved.

source_resolution_review.observation: At 320px and 200% root text, the full placeholder and focus ring fit; both result rows and the wrapped participant action remain within the panel.
Long channel names truncate within their rows; contextual actions, connected voice dock and profile footer stay visible.
Channel rows remain inside the sidebar with one scrollable list. A transient “Навигация” hint is visible at the main-pane edge in the initial fixture capture.
Desktop Quick Jump query, result and close control fit the right-side panel without horizontal overflow.
Touch Quick Jump fills the narrow viewport; query, result description and close control remain visible.
The text conversation, member rail, composer and connected voice controls remain available together.
The navigation drawer keeps channel search and rows reachable, with the profile footer visible at the bottom.
The desktop statistics panel stays inside the viewer; sender confirmation and receiver dimensions/FPS are separately labelled.
The mobile statistics sheet wraps its labels and values; close, technical details and copy action remain visible. Unknown receiver FPS remains explicit.

limits: This record covers focused behavior, the Quick Jump before/after pair and nine selected current-run captures; 854 unique #353 images remain unreviewed.
The #305 release gate remains NO-GO / NOT_RUN until auditable measurements for all eight UX tasks and the named Web rollback owner are recorded.
Generated screenshots remain ignored local artifacts and are not committed.
